title: Diagnostic DNA Methylation Signature in Diagnosing Thyroid Cancer After Fine-Needle Aspiration in Patients With Thyroid Nodules
official: Retrospective-Prospective Collection of Thyroid Specimens After FNA
summary: This trial studies how well the diagnostic deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methylation signature works in detecting thyroid cancer in patients with thyroid nodules. Using diagnostic testing, such as the diagnostic DNA methylation signature, may be a less invasive way to check for thyroid cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients undergoing FNA for thyroid nodule diagnosis.
* Any race and ethnicity are eligible for the study.
* Patient should have thyroid nodule(s) with indeterminate diagnosis after FNA (Bethesda category of indeterminate FNA \[III-V\]).
